name: Flexing for Nougat
summary: In Orgrimmar, Innkeeper Gryshka offers nougat to those who play along. During Hallow's End, she asks you to flex for a piece meant to cheer Spoops, a bedridden child.

sections.title: Tricks for Treats
sections.body: Hallow's End brings pranks and sweet-gathering to Azeroth's capitals. In Orgrimmar's inn, Innkeeper Gryshka keeps holiday sweets for those who take part in the season's custom. You face dragons and dark sorcery in your travels, but here the bargain is simple: perform a trick or leave without a treat.

sections.title: Muscle on Display
sections.body: Innkeeper Gryshka wants a display of Orcish strength before she gives you Orgrimmar Nougat for young Spoops. Whatever disguise or armor you wear, she asks you to strike a muscular pose. Even the Horde's feared combatants can be made to entertain the common folk for candy.

faq.q: Who is asking for the flex?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Gryshka, who keeps the main tavern in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength, asks you to perform a trick before she hands over holiday sweets.

faq.q: Why do I need to flex for candy?
faq.answer: Hallow's End custom calls for a small trick in exchange for a treat. Gryshka teases you by asking for a display of sheer physical power before she gives you candy.

faq.q: What is the Orgrimmar Nougat used for?
faq.answer: The nougat is one of four sweets gathered across the Horde's capitals to cheer Spoops, a sick orphan boy who is bedridden and cannot go trick-or-treating on his own.
Innkeeper Gryshka keeps the counter at the main inn in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength, where she serves weary travelers and locals.

faq.q: Can any Horde member participate in this?
faq.answer: Yes. Any member of the Horde can visit Innkeeper Gryshka during Hallow's End, strike a pose, and claim the seasonal sweet.

faq.q: What holiday is this a part of?
faq.answer: It is part of Hallow's End, an autumn festival marking the end of the harvest and defying mortality with costumes, pranks, and sweets.

angles.text: Even veteran Horde champions who face deadly warlords flex their biceps for tavernkeepers to gather festive sweets for the children.
As an Orc, you meet a holiday test of pride when Orgrimmar's innkeeper asks for an impressive display of muscle.
As a Warrior, you may take pride in devastating feats on the front lines, yet find it amusing or humbling to pose like a stage performer for festive candy.
